title: RouteRefused payload
description: The delegation names a model route the daemon does not declare, or names none and the daemon has no default route: the run was not submitted. `routes` lists the routes the daemon declares, by name; no address, token or alias is in the answer. The handler looks the route up and reports the fact in `route_declared`.

route.description: The route the delegation named; absent when it named none.

routes.description: The routes the daemon declares, in order of name.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
